$comment: Ethnic composition and regional concentration, authored for OpenDoctrines. Country composition figures are drawn from public-domain reference sources (principally the CIA World Factbook 'Ethnic groups' field, a work of the US Government) and from published national census summaries; the figures here are rounded, edited for playability and are not a reproduction of any single third-party dataset. Concentration boxes are hand-drawn by the project. No dataset under a research-only or unstated licence is used.
